title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with our city-by-city guide, comparing prices from $15-$50/week
intro: Auckland has numerous gym options, but finding the right one can be overwhelming. With prices ranging from $15 to $50 per week, it's essential to compare gyms by suburb, contract terms, and amenities. This guide will help you make an informed decision.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, with options like Les Mills, Anytime Fitness, and Jetts. These gyms offer convenient locations, but prices vary greatly. Les Mills, for example, costs around $30 per week, while Anytime Fitness is priced at $20 per week.

sections.heading: Gyms by Suburb
list: Auckland CBD: Les Mills, Anytime Fitness, Jetts

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms
sections.body: Commuter gyms are ideal for those who want to work out before or after work. Options like Jetts and Anytime Fitness have 24/7 access, making them perfect for busy professionals. Prices start from $14.95 per week for Jetts and $19.95 per week for Anytime Fitness.

sections.heading: Parking and Accessibility
sections.body: Parking and accessibility are crucial factors when choosing a gym. The Auckland CBD has limited parking options, but gyms like Les Mills and CityFitness offer convenient parking facilities. Suburban gyms, on the other hand, often have ample parking spaces.

sections.heading: Next Steps
sections.body: Now that you've compared the best gyms in Auckland, it's time to find the perfect one for you. Check out our in-depth review of Les Mills Auckland CBD or visit our comparison page to find the best gym deals.
